note:
Reviewed opposing identities: The Union and Confederate forces are identified by the naval accounts. Richmond and Ivy supply representative components; the mixed Confederate flotilla, including Manassas, is not reduced to an exact ship reconstruction. Unavailable quantities stay empty, so these identities support an illustrative engagement rather than proportional forces.

Equipment review: Richmond supplies the Union screw-sloop analogy, while the Confederate sidewheel tow-gunboat Ivy supplies the paddle-steamer analogy. These represent documented components, not all vessels or the armoured ram Manassas. The participant account identifies Hollins’ Confederate naval force; no strengths or losses are inferred.
